text:
maria_infra: heads-up, ap-northeast2 started dropping GPU provisioning events ~ 08:12 UTC, services show low available capacity and prometheus scrapes are missing for the gpu-pool exporters.
ali_oncall: seeing it too, UI shows 0/16 available in gpu-pool-3, autoscaler attempts queued.
danny_sre: any network changes? egress rules?
maria_infra: not from infra side, but I see a flurry of denied connections in the fw logs to external metrics ingest. suspect egress throttle from infra provider.
ali_oncall: copying logs: `2026-03-17T08:12:34Z kube-proxy: connection refused to 10.10.3.5:4317 exporter`
ali_oncall: prometheus targets show UNKNOWN for node-exporter and gpu-exporter.
ravi_obs: otel traces show exporter errors: `grpc: connection closed` and `timeout while sending spans` - looks like short-lived egress blackholes.
danny_sre: rolling through quick checks — `kubectl get pods -n gpu-pool -o wide | grep -E "CrashLoop|Evicted"` returns a few Evicted jobs but mostly Running. main issue is scrape gap.
maria_infra: oncall-bot: triggered region-failover? (no) someone manually shifted traffic earlier?
deploy-bot: @maria_infra no automatic region failover in last 6h.
ali_oncall: immediate mitigation: redirect internal metrics to the observability VPC peering as fallback. can we flip the route?
danny_sre: we can add a local push gateway as a temporary sink. I'll deploy a metrics-forwarder sidecar on gpu-pool nodes that batches and forwards to a different egress IP. quick manifest:
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: metrics-forwarder
spec:
  containers:
  - name: forwarder
    image: internal/metrics-forwarder:stable
    env:
      - name: TARGET_EGRESS
        value: "10.200.5.7:9091"
```

maria_infra: doing a small rollout to 3 nodes now. watching prometheus target status.
(5m later)
maria_infra: prometheus target for gpu-exporter -> UP for the forwarded IP :thumbsup: partial recovery of scrapes.
ravi_obs: note: traces still show occasional `dial tcp: i/o timeout` -> likely intermittent provider-level network shaping.
ali_oncall: question on root cause: why did prometheus stop scraping instead of buffering metrics locally?
danny_sre: because gpu-exporter had no push fallback, metrics were lost on scrape failure. exporter didn't retry long enough and our prometheus scrape timeout is 10s.
ravi_obs: propose quick instrumentation fixes: 1) bump scrape timeout to 30s for gpu-exporter job, 2) add local ring buffer to gpu-exporter to allow short egress blips, 3) add synthetic pod-level heartbeat metric to detect scrape blackholes earlier.
maria_infra: agree. I'll open infra change to allow peering egress IPs and request provider escalate for transient shaping. raising a change: `CHG-6872 allow observability-egress to ap-northeast2`
ali_oncall: also we should avoid full failover — customers on dedicated have capacity constraints. schedule traffic shift plan: traffic -> eu-west1 until capacity stable.
danny_sre: created a quick PR to prometheus config to bump timeout and add relabel to hit fallback endpoint. PR: https://git.internal/r/prom-config/merge_requests/402
ravi_obs: I'll add an instrumentation ticket with test prompts and unit-tests for the exporter buffer: #INSTR-912. We should also add an alert: `Alert: prometheus_scrape_gap{job="gpu-exporter"} >= 2` -> escalate to infra oncall.
maria_infra: timeline: 08:12 detection, 08:18 deploy forwarders, 08:30 partial scrapes restored, 09:00 prometheus config rolled (timeout increased), 10:45 provider confirmed transient egress shaping and released throttle.
ali_oncall: longterm actions: put exporter push-fallback, add egress healthcheck and route fallback, document regional provisioning backpressure behavior for capacity planner.
danny_sre: will schedule a postmortem and include metrics backfill plan to reconstruct missing telemetry from buffered agent logs where available.
maria_infra: can someone add an entry in incidents tracker and tag product & customers impacted?
ali_oncall: on it, filing INC-2026-033 -> linking to support tickets.
otel-bot: automated note: traces missing for window 2026-03-17T08:10:00Z -> 2026-03-17T09:05:00Z.
ravi_obs: action items: [maria_infra] request provider escalate + peering change, [danny_sre] push exporter buffer PR, [ravi_obs] add scrape alert + synthetic heartbeat, [ali_oncall] run customer impact sweep.
maria_infra: thanks all. will update channel when provider confirms egress policy change. :white_check_mark:
ali_oncall: good recovery, let's keep the fallback tooling in infra-runbooks.
(END)
